method: _usage_report executed verbatim (exec of runtime.py:79-88 def, dataclass + plain-object probes). Claim/fail/sweep SQL + result rows recorded as ORM shapes verbatim from source (no live DB; compiler-form SQL, shape-derived rows per precedent). Beat entries read verbatim from celery.py with interval settings keys from settings/common.py. Outcome state machine read verbatim from run_cloud_agent.

claim.shape: atomic: select_for_update QUEUED cloud run + created_by; lock workspace; count RUNNING; over cap -> lease=now+rand(backoff/2..3*backoff/2), save(lease only), return None; else status=RUNNING, started_at=now, lease=None, save(3 fields); append run_started; re-fetch with relations
claim.after_capped: status stays queued, lease_expires_at pushed by random backoff

fail.shape: finalize_agent_run(run_id, FAILED, {error_code: code[:64], error: (detail or code)[:16000]})

run_outcomes.unauthorized: creator inactive/bot/non-member or no project role -> fail actor_no_longer_authorized
run_outcomes.llm_config_missing: no LLM config -> fail llm_config_missing (pre-check + LLMConfigMissing catch)
run_outcomes.cancelled: cancel_requested_at set (pre or post model) -> CANCELLED
run_outcomes.completed: outcome completed/noop -> COMPLETED with done_payload {v:1, executor:cloud_agent, status, summary, evidence, tool_calls, writes, limitations} + usage counters
run_outcomes.failed: other exceptions -> fail(exc.code or classify code, sanitized text); SoftTimeLimit/TimeoutError -> run_timeout
run_outcomes.master_recheck: cloud_agent_is_configured() re-checked after model boundary -> disabled

scan_queued_runs.shape: expire rows older than MAX_QUEUE_AGE (batch SCAN_BATCH, fail dispatch_timeout); collect queued workspace ids ordered by oldest; CLOUD_AGENT_ENABLED False -> fail all queued cloud_agent_disabled, return 0; else sum dispatch_waiting per workspace

sweep_stale_runs.shape: RUNNING rows older than cutoff (batch SCAN_BATCH): cancel_requested -> CANCELLED else FAILED run_timeout ('worker was lost or exceeded its deadline'); returns count

expire_waiting_runs.shape: QUEUED managed rows older than cutoff (first 500): finalize FAILED expected_status=QUEUED {error_code: desktop_not_connected, error: 'never came online...'}; returns expired count

beat_entries_owned.out_of_scope: agent-run-reconcile-terminal-effects belongs to the runner domain (D-13...D-15), not ported here

ported_quirks: creation.py:84-85 carries admission failures under the pseudo-key _cloud_admission_error (not an AgentRun column); callers must pop it before objects.create — kept as-is.
events.py:24 silently truncates kind to 64 chars (kind[:64]) — kept as-is.
errors.py:20 truncates sanitized text to 16000 chars before classify_error matches on it (errors.py:35) — kept as-is.
admission.py:40-42 documents that concurrent bursts may slightly overshoot the per-minute rate; the workspace queue cap is the hard limit — kept as-is.
